topic_title: Driving is a Privilege — Risk, Responsibilities & Consequences
prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §545.412, which child passenger is legally required to be secured in an approved child safety seat system?

options.text: Any child under six years old regardless of their physical height or weight
Any child under eight years old unless the child is taller than 4 feet 9 inches
Any child under ten years old seated anywhere in the front passenger compartment
Any child under twelve years old who weighs less than seventy-five total pounds
